title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ Lesson 22 ]

items.text: How much do I owe you?
alternatives: What do I owe you?
How much money do I owe you?

items.text: You owe me nothing.
alternatives: You don't owe me anything.
You don't owe me a thing.

items.text: The dessert is on the house.
alternatives: Dessert is on the house.
The dessert's on the house.

items.text: This is the right way to the station.
alternatives: This is the right road to the station.

items.text: Will you do me a favor?
alternatives: Can you do me a favor?
Could you do me a favor?
Would you do me a favor?
Will you do me a favour?

items.text: Moderate exercise will do you good.
alternatives: Proper exercise will do you good.
Appropriate exercise will do you good.

items.text: Too much exercise will do you harm.
He did research on rockets.
alternatives: He did research into rockets.

items.text: Where are we?
You came at the right time.
You came on time.
alternatives: You arrived on time.

items.text: We are short of hands.
alternatives: We are short on hands.

items.text: Will you give me a lift?
alternatives: Will you give me a ride?
Can you give me a ride?
Could you give me a lift?
Can you give me a lift?
Would you give me a lift?
Could you give me a ride?

items.text: Let's give him a big hand.
I must buy him a pair of shoes.
alternatives: I have to buy him a pair of shoes.
I should buy him a pair of shoes.
I need to buy him a pair of shoes.

items.text: I bought a hamburger for myself.
alternatives: I bought myself a hamburger.
I bought a burger for myself.

items.text: What are friends for?
What's a few thousand dollars?
alternatives: What's several thousand dollars?

items.text: She is the greatest orator I've ever seen.
alternatives: She is the greatest speaker I've ever seen.

items.text: I'd like to open a savings account.
alternatives: I want to open a savings account.

items.text: His check bounced.
alternatives: His cheque bounced.

items.text: Are there any vending machines near here?
alternatives: Are there any vending machines around here?
Is there any vending machine near here?
Are there any vending machines nearby?
